questions.stem: A 20-year-old man presents with 6-week painless enlargement of cervical nodes with rubbery consistency, fever, weight loss and loss of appetite. Excisional node biopsy is shown below. Which of the following is correct about this case?
questions.stemHtml: A 20-year-old man presents with 6-week painless enlargement of cervical nodes with rubbery consistency, fever, weight loss and loss of appetite. Excisional node biopsy is shown below. Which of the following is correct about this case?

options.label: A
options.text: Sarcoidosis with non-caseating granulomas and elevated ACE

options.label: B
options.text: Cat-scratch disease with stellate suppurative granulomas

options.label: C
options.text: Hodgkin lymphoma with classical RS cells
